name: MarkStrideAlign
scope: The hivm-mark-stride-align pass itself: its mark-decision logic (which buffer, which dimension, how many bytes), the exact annotation it emits, its helper passes PreMarkStrideAlign and the shared createAlignMarkOp/adjustAlignDim utilities, the regbase alignStoragePipeline placement, and the mark contract its consumer hivm-enable-stride-align relies on. Excludes the internal mechanics of the consumer's re-allocation engine (a separate bundle) and the membase (A2/A3) lowering details beyond what the shared code shows.

related_entities.name: PreMarkStrideAlign (hivm-pre-mark-stride-align)
related_entities.relation: sibling producer pass run immediately before it; marks vload'd DMA root allocs with skip_stride_align_for_vload so MarkStrideAlign skips them

related_entities.name: EnableStrideAlign (hivm-enable-stride-align)
related_entities.relation: downstream consumer; re-allocates buffers according to the stride_align marks this pass emits

related_entities.name: hivm.stride_align_dims / hivm.stride_align_value_in_byte (HIVMAttrs.td)
related_entities.relation: the mark attributes this pass creates on annotation.mark ops

related_entities.name: hivm.skip_stride_align_for_vload (HIVMAttrs.td)
related_entities.relation: the veto attribute PreMarkStrideAlign writes and MarkStrideAlign reads via shouldSkipStrideAlignForVLoad

related_entities.name: annotation.mark (Annotation dialect)
related_entities.relation: the op used to carry the mark; created by shared helper createAlignMarkOp in PropagateAlignUtil.cpp

related_entities.name: alignStoragePipeline (HIVMRegbasePipelines.cpp)
related_entities.relation: the regbase pipeline stage that instantiates PreMarkStrideAlign -> MarkStrideAlign -> FoldAllocReshape -> EnableStrideAlign under the enableHIVMAutoStorageAlign gate

related_entities.name: enableHIVMAutoStorageAlign (Options.td EnableHIVMAutoStorageAlign)
related_entities.relation: pipeline option (bool, default true) that gates whether the pass runs at all

related_entities.name: getHWAlignBytes / BL = VL/8 = 32 (HIVM Utils)
related_entities.relation: hardware constant supplying the default stride-align byte value for UB/L1 buffers

why_this_subject: Phase T3 dogfood, multi-pass system story: MarkStrideAlign is the producer half of a two-pass contract (mark here, re-allocate in hivm-enable-stride-align). It is the one pass that decides WHERE stride alignment is needed and records it as pure metadata, so understanding it is a prerequisite for understanding the A5/RegBase UB memory-layout story; it also demonstrates an annotation-only pass whose entire effect is a downstream contract.
